= {quarkus-cxf-project-name} 3.40.3 LTS release notes

// AI-generated by Codex on behalf of Peter Palaga.

== Important dependency upgrades

* Apache CXF 4.2.3 -> 4.2.4 - https://cxf.apache.org/cxf-424-release-notes.html[release notes], link:https://github.com/apache/cxf/compare/cxf-4.2.3+++...+++cxf-4.2.4[changelog], fixed CVEs (see the https://cxf.apache.org/security-advisories.html[Apache CXF security advisories] for details):
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78384[CVE-2026-78384] Unbounded DEFLATE decompression can exhaust memory (`org.apache.cxf:cxf-core`)
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-97468[CVE-2026-97468] Weak cache keys for validated STS tokens can bypass authentication (`org.apache.cxf:cxf-rt-ws-security` and `org.apache.cxf.services.sts:cxf-services-sts-core`)
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-97791[CVE-2026-97791] Shared validation state in `STSTokenValidator` can allow untrusted SAML assertions (`org.apache.cxf:cxf-rt-ws-security`)
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-107937[CVE-2026-107937] Repeated or folded attachment headers can bypass size and count limits, exhausting memory (`org.apache.cxf:cxf-core`)
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-108039[CVE-2026-108039] Missing default XML element and character limits can cause excessive memory and CPU usage (`org.apache.cxf:cxf-core`)

== Documentation improvements

=== https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-cxf/issues/1449[#1449] Document that the whole class hierarchy of a service implementation must be available in Jandex

The new xref:user-guide/advanced-service-topics/service-classes-in-jandex.adoc[Service classes from other modules] guide
explains how to index service interfaces and superclasses supplied by dependencies, including other modules of the same project.

Before {quarkus-cxf-project-name} 3.40.3, the build error for a service interface missing from Jandex contained an unresolved documentation attribute.
Since {quarkus-cxf-project-name} 3.40.3, the message contains a working link to the Quarkus indexing documentation.

Special thanks to https://github.com/rolfedh[@rolfedh] for contributing the guide and error message fix.

=== SOAP endpoint paths

* The xref:user-guide/advanced-service-topics/rest-and-soap-endpoints.adoc[SOAP and REST endpoints in the same application] guide
  explains how to avoid routing conflicts with Quarkus REST, RESTEasy Classic and reactive routes.
* The xref:user-guide/advanced-client-topics/client-endpoint-url-defaults.adoc[Client endpoint URL defaults] guide
  now accounts for the default `/services` value of `xref:reference/extensions/quarkus-cxf.adoc#quarkus-cxf_quarkus-cxf-path[quarkus.cxf.path]`.

== Breaking changes

=== Default limits on XML parsing and decompression

Before {quarkus-cxf-project-name} 3.40.3 and 3.33.15, CXF imposed no default limit on the total number of XML elements,
the total number of XML characters, or the output size of `CompressionUtils.inflate()`.
Since {quarkus-cxf-project-name} 3.40.3 and 3.33.15, the defaults are 5,000,000 elements,
268,435,456 XML characters and 10 MiB of decompressed data, respectively.
Applications processing larger inputs may need to adjust these limits.
See https://cxf.apache.org/security-advisories.data/CVE-2026-108039.txt[CVE-2026-108039]
and https://cxf.apache.org/security-advisories.data/CVE-2026-78384.txt[CVE-2026-78384] for the corresponding CXF system properties.
For native mode, those properties have to be set at build time.
